{"reason": "Six of eight listed false-arbitration rows have confidence 0.44-0.67, all below the 0.7 high-confidence bar (recall had 1.0 slack above the 0.8 gate). Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) as a conjunct prunes those low-trust arbitrations, cutting the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate without touching magnitude, exposure, or frozen-horizon logic.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
